preconditions.description: The number of elements in the sequence is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output is a string of length n

postconditions.expression: character '1' if a_i belongs to no longest increasing subsequence
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string represents the group to which the index i in the input sequence belongs.

postconditions.expression: character '2' if a_i belongs to at least one but not every longest increasing subsequence
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string represents the group to which the index i in the input sequence belongs.

postconditions.expression: character '3' if a_i belongs to every longest increasing subsequence
